## Completed work

`analysis.py` (end-to-end, deterministic, ~2.5 min runtime) and `results/modes.csv` are written; full evidence in `results/diagnostics.txt`.

**Method (as approved):** variable-projection joint fit — inner per-curve bounded linear LS (`lsq_linear`, a0 free, a_k≥0) for (a0_m, a_mk); outer `least_squares` (trf) on shared (log10 τ_k, φ_k) with bounds log10 τ∈[−6,4], φ∈[0.02,1]; 30 multistarts per K (consensus seeds + random log-uniform), clustering by sorted-τ; K=2..6 selected by joint BIC (N=960, p=5(K+1)+2K) + weak-mode/degeneracy rule + underfit guard.

**Result: K = 5** (min BIC −5243.7 vs K=4 −5119.1, K=6 −5226.3). `results/modes.csv` (tau ascending; a_m = mode amplitude in curve m):

| tau | x-centre 1/tau | phi | a_0 | a_1 | a_2 | a_3 | a_4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0.0022077 | 453 | 0.834 | 1.098 | 1.176 | 1.176 | 1.328 | 0.948 |
| 0.036422 | 27.5 | 0.876 | 0.711 | 0.798 | 0.780 | 1.018 | 0.972 |
| 1.072878 | 0.932 | 0.918 | 0.749 | 0.820 | 0.952 | 0.952 | 0.971 |
| 38.867 | 0.0257 | 0.887 | 0.991 | 0.864 | 1.023 | 0.927 | 1.372 |
| 342.55 | 0.0029 | 0.020 | 0.123 | 0.640 | 0.681 | 0.143 | 0.301 |

**Key evidence** (all printed in diagnostics.txt): BIC table above; K=4 residuals systematically autocorrelated (im curve 1: +0.34; re curves 0/2/4: +0.16/+0.22/+0.17) vs K=5 white; cross-validation (even/odd x splits): K=5 test SSE 1.692/1.371 vs K=4 2.063/1.686 → the 5th component generalizes, not overfitting; K=4 systematically overestimates |Im| in the high-x tail (all 5 curves), which the 5th mode corrects. Per-curve rms 0.0507–0.0637 (joint 0.05646), max|resid| 0.1825, cond(A_m)=15.8, winning cluster 17/30 restarts with log10(τ) spread 0.012 dec. No φ at the Debye upper bound; mode 5 pinned at the φ lower bound (very broad).

**Requested K=5 weak-mode check:** the exploratory per-curve candidate near 1/τ≈1050 does **not** persist in any joint (shared) fit — no K=4/5/6 solution has a mode with 1/τ∈(800,1400); it was a curve-specific artifact with no support in the other curves, so it is rejected by the shared-mode requirement (noted in diagnostics). The genuine K=5 extra mode is instead a very broad (φ→small) relaxation; its per-curve amplitudes are well determined, but its (τ, φ) sit on an SSE-flat ridge (φ5∈[0.02,0.3] and x-centre∈[0.01,1e6] all fit within 6e-5 rms) — the reported τ=342.5 is the maximum-likelihood representative of that ridge.

**Determinism:** two full runs produced byte-identical `modes.csv` and `diagnostics.txt`.

## Limitations
1. Mode 5's centre is not identifiable from this window (flat ridge); if the true generating mode lies elsewhere on the ridge (e.g., centre beyond the right window edge), the reported τ may differ, though its amplitude and smooth-drift contribution are well determined.
2. BIC assumes iid Gaussian equal-variance noise; a0 left sign-free (fitted ≈ ±0.012).
3. Outer bounds (log10 τ∈[−6,4], φ∈[0.02,1]): mode 5 touches the φ bound, indicating an extremely broad relaxation; the four main modes are well inside bounds and stable (cluster spread 0.012 dec in log10 τ).

modes.note: broad mode, phi=0.02 bound-pinned, centre on SSE-flat ridge
